claim: Which way two bodies face each other, a separate axis from where they stand. Facing is confrontation, side_by_side is alliance, back_to_back is either total trust or a conversation that has already failed.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: 2boys, angled toward each other, three-quarter view
2boys, side-by-side, shoulder to shoulder, facing same direction
2boys, one facing viewer, one turned away, facing away
2boys, over the shoulder, back to viewer, other boy facing viewer
